status: Provisional ranking among reviewed engineers; evidence review is selective.

methodology.formula: Sum of the three strongest reviewed initiative scores; each = outcome (0–4) + reach (0–3). Maximum 21.
methodology.ties: Equal scores receive equal ranks. Alphabetical display order is not a tie-break judgment.
methodology.limitations: Complete merged-PR collection is distinct from selective evidence review: 46 of 17,027 PRs reviewed in depth, spanning 25 of 193 identified human authors. Review depth varies and unreviewed work is not zero impact. Scores are ordinal analyst judgments; small differences do not establish definitive individual superiority.
methodology.evidence: Relevant diff excerpts inspected; tests and benchmarks not independently executed.
methodology.confidence: Reported measurements are labeled separately; scores are analyst judgments, not measured business impact.
